name: 暮雨流花+
detailed_description:
What does a native family mean to you?

Is it hope? Is it backed by mountains? Is it the source of motivation or the shackles that hinder you?

What has your family of origin brought you?

Is it pain or happiness?

Looking back at your family of origin, what do you feel?

Is it a mixture of conflicting love and hate, or can one proudly stand tall?

The purpose of this work is to heal the impact brought by the family of origin. If you have related problems, it can help you gain relief from similar issues

——The end of escape is death. Given this, can you muster the courage to fight for the life you want with both hands?

This work answers such a question

Not related to the previous topic of depression, this work discusses Chinese families, and the two are relatively independent stories

From depression to family background, although not to everyone's taste, it is worth seeing. Because these people do indeed exist, it is necessary to be seen and recorded

"I hope the shining days can last forever"

Stay tuned, the wonderful story of evening rain and flowing flowers +

What game is this?

Answer: This is a visual novel

What does the game talk about?

Answer: This work tells the story of a boy and a girl

It tells the story of teenagers and girls from different family backgrounds who understand and save each other

The only theme of the Twilight series is loneliness. If you like the feeling of being alone in the house in the rainstorm, and if you like standing alone on the balcony in the evening blowing the wind at the junction of summer and autumn, please try this work

The content of this work is about a girl trapped in loneliness and the efforts and results she makes in the face of this loneliness. It is a journey of loneliness that combines laughter, joy, and coldness

What are the differences and connections between this work and its predecessor?

Answer: Compared to the previous installment, we have made significant progress that I am proud of

Yes, now we have a painting genius. Please allow me to introduce you to the great teacher Cyanyarc. With her joining, everything has changed

She is not stingy with her outstanding and skilled painting skills, creating impressive characters for this work. Not only that, she also took care of all the graphic design related matters for this work alone, creating a stunning visual effect

With her help, I can confidently say that there is nothing in this work that makes me more proud than art

On the basis of solving the most criticized painting problem in the previous work, we have also significantly upgraded the UI, making it more beautiful and highly practical

Like its predecessor, this work still has an extremely exquisite atmosphere with copyright free music

This work has almost no relationship with its predecessor. It is an independent story with a relatively rounded beginning and end, so even if you haven't purchased it before, you can still fully understand it

What are the features of this game?

Answer: Pure love and complete hatred, the open and open flow of emotions, give you unprecedented emotional impact

2 satisfying, smooth, and seamless scripts

3 fresh and delicious exquisite standing paintings and illustrations

4 highly realistic woodcut field shots

What is the approximate duration of the game?

Answer: The script is about 12W words long and can be completed in about four hours

What should I pay attention to before playing games?

Answer: Please do not play this game on rainy days, otherwise you will be responsible for the consequences

Due to the large number of required scenes and some scenes being quite tricky and difficult to reproduce and replicate in reality, some scenes were assisted by AI - but don't worry! That's all, except for a few background images, the rest are manually drawn

This game has no bad memes or stitching, and the theme is realism. Before purchasing, please make sure to check whether it is a theme that interests you

This work has no selected limbs. There is only one route, one ending

This work may contain some uncomfortable points, please make sure that some of the themes are within your tolerance

How can I ensure my financial interests?

Answer: We offer it for free

The birth of this work is almost entirely attributed to the great Salty Areas (SAS cyan'arc) teacher. Thank you for her participation, which made my dream, which seemed so fanciful five years ago, come true

As the author's second work, this work holds great significance for me. Thank you very much to every player who has completed this game. I hope you can enjoy the journey of Twilight Rain and Flowing Flowers+. At the same time, I am also very grateful to the players who have accompanied me all the way. Because of you, I can become more mature step by step. Thank you for all the criticisms, suggestions, and corrections I have received in the past, and thank you to everyone who has read this game and expressed their opinions
